# Strava Developers

> > Official documentation and API reference for building applications with the Strava V3 API, featuring OAuth 2.0 authentication, webhooks, and REST endpoints for athlete and activity data.

The Strava Developer Platform provides comprehensive resources for integrating with Strava's fitness tracking ecosystem. Developers can access athlete profiles, activities, routes, and real-time updates through a RESTful API with OAuth 2.0 authentication, rate limiting, and webhook support.

## Key Topics

- Strava V3 API
- OAuth 2.0 authentication
- REST API endpoints
- Webhook Events API
- Access tokens and refresh tokens
- Rate limits
- Activity data
- Athlete profiles
- API authorization scopes
- Swagger Playground
- cURL examples
- ISO 8601 standards
- Developer community
- Brand guidelines

## Getting Started

- [Strava Developers](https://developers.strava.com/): Strava API developer platform homepage and community hub
- [Getting Started Guide](https://developers.strava.com/docs/getting-started/): Getting started guide for Strava API with OAuth 2.0 and rate limits
- [API Documentation](https://developers.strava.com/docs/): Strava V3 API documentation with OAuth and Swagger Codegen support

## API Reference

- [REST API Reference](https://developers.strava.com/docs/reference/): Strava REST API reference with endpoints and ISO 8601 standards

## Authentication & Authorization

- [OAuth Updates](https://developers.strava.com/docs/oauth-updates/): OAuth migration guide for refresh tokens and authorization scopes

## Webhooks & Events

- [Webhook Events API](https://developers.strava.com/docs/webhooks/): Webhook Events API guide for real-time activity and athlete updates
